name: Manoj Kanagaraj
current_role: Co-Founder and Chief Strategy Officer, Grow Therapy (earlier titled COO)
profile: Manoj Kanagaraj, MD, co-founded Grow Therapy in 2020 with Duke college friends Jake Cooper and Alan Ni. Grow helps therapists run insurance-covered practices (~26,000 providers, $328M+ raised, ~$3B valuation). He leads partnerships, care delivery and research innovation.
interesting_fact: A physician by training, he earned his medical degree from Harvard Medical School and studied at Harvard Business School while building Grow.
deep_cut_fact: Before Grow he was a technology/venture fellow at Harvard (Harvard Innovation Labs), per Grow's own team listings.
notes: Deep-cut is from a secondary startup directory; verify before use. Grow comms head is best route.

name: Liu Yongjian
current_role: Listed founder of DCG (Wuhan Polytechnic Digital Communication Group), per Hurun
profile: DCG is a Wuhan (Optics Valley) company founded in 2014 that provides big-data and media-convergence services to China's publishing industry (RAYS system, BOOKSGPT AI model). It was named a China Unicorn Enterprise for 2023 by the Great Wall Enterprise Institute. No public English-language profile of Liu Yongjian was found.
interesting_fact: DCG's BOOKSGPT model powers 'AI editors' that take part in production stages at publishing houses; it launched in June 2024.
notes: Could not confirm his title or Chinese name characters (possibly 刘永坚). Company identification via https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/dcg/96245 . Chinese-language registry check needed.

name: Ramanathan RV
current_role: Co-Founder and CEO, Hyperface (Bengaluru credit-card-issuance platform)
profile: Ramanathan R.V. co-founded Juspay in 2012 and served as its CTO, after earlier engineering roles at Amazon and BankBazaar. He left Juspay to co-found Hyperface (2021), a card-issuance-as-a-service platform that says it powers 8.5M+ credit cards. He is also an angel investor.
interesting_fact: Hyperface says it powers 8.5M+ credit cards and 20M+ transactions a month for banks across India and Southeast Asia.
deep_cut_fact: As Juspay's co-founding CTO he helped build BHIM, India's first UPI app.
notes: No longer at Juspay; listed in Hurun as Juspay founder. Departure date varies by source (2019 vs 2021).

name: Karthik Venkateswaran
profile: S. Karthik Venkateswaran co-founded Jumbotail in 2015 with Stanford GSB classmate Ashish Jhina. Jumbotail is a B2B marketplace and 'New Retail' platform for India's kirana grocery stores; it became a unicorn after a $120M Series D led by SC Ventures in June 2025, acquired Solv India, and took a strategic investment from NEC in 2026.
interesting_fact: Before tech, he served 10 years in the Indian Army (rising to major), including high-altitude and counter-terrorism tours, then worked at eBay (US) and Flipkart.
deep_cut_fact: He is an alumnus of both the National Defence Academy and the Indian Military Academy, and was a fellow of the Unreasonable Impact World Forum 2023.
